IVX HOLDINGS — 24/7 AUTONOMOUS ENGINEERING MAPPING

OBJECTIVE

Build the IVX Engineering Operating System where IVX IA Developers work continuously to improve, maintain, test, and expand the IVX platform.

The owner remains the only authority for production approvals.

====================================================
OWNER
====================================================

                IVAN CIFUENTES
                     │
                     ▼
          OWNER CONTROL CENTER
     (Approve • Reject • Monitor)

                     │
                     ▼

====================================================
IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER (MASTER AI)
====================================================

Responsibilities

• Receive owner goals
• Break work into tasks
• Assign work
• Review code
• Merge approved work
• Deploy production
• Generate proof ledger
• Report every 2 hours

No production deployment without owner approval.

====================================================
FUTURE APP FACTORY
====================================================

After IVX production is stable:

IVX Master AI

creates

FA-01
FA-02
...
FA-50

Each agent:

• unique responsibility
• own proof ledger
• own task queue
• owner-controlled
• no direct production deployment

====================================================
RULES
====================================================

1. Never create a second IVX app.
2. Continue using the existing Expo application.
3. Build reusable modules instead of duplicate code.
4. Every completed module becomes part of the IVX Core Platform.
5. No feature is marked VERIFIED without:
   - GitHub commit SHA
   - Render deployment ID
   - automated test results
   - live health verification
6. Every AI works continuously, but production changes require owner approval.
7. Every 2 hours, publish:
   - completed tasks
   - active tasks
   - blockers
   - deployments
   - production health
   - next priorities
